summary: Frontend-only verification of APK PRINT_RECEIPT bridge in KioskLayout (sendApkPrint + PaymentConfirm). All three scenarios pass: (1) APK-mock + method Contant, (2) APK-mock + method Bankoverschrijving, (3) plain browser (no mock). The console.log('[APK PRINT_RECEIPT]', msg) fires BEFORE window.ReactNativeWebView.postMessage, exactly one message is pushed per payment, and all data fields are correctly formatted.
critical_code_review_comments: sendApkPrint (KioskLayout.jsx line 2396) is clean and small; console.log fires before the optional postMessage, satisfying the requirement.

KioskLayout.jsx is 5317 lines — significantly over the 700-line recommended threshold. Consider splitting into submodules (PaymentConfirm, PaymentReceipt, Overview, PinLogin, etc.) for maintainability.
fmtPrintDate uses local time without timezone info in the string; acceptable for a kiosk printer but note it depends on device clock.
